create_task_env: create an Aloha sim task environment by calling create_task_env with a task name and time limit
list_available_tasks: list all available task names by inspecting the TASK_FACTORIES dictionary keys
create_drawer_open_env: create a DrawerOpen task environment using create_task_env with task_name DrawerOpen and a time limit
create_blocks_spelling_env: create a BlocksSpelling task environment using create_task_env with task_name BlocksSpelling and a time limit
